2014_spells.create-homunculus.effectSumm: Make a target incapacitated until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.create-homunculus.fullDescri: Using 1 hour, while speaking a dark incantation, you cut your palm, shedding blood to fuel the spell, and then touch a gemstone, which must be a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp, which is consumed by the spell. The gemstone cracks and a homunculus servant appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you; If you are incapacitated or die, the homunculus becomes hostile and seeks to harm any creature it encounters. The homunculus is under your control until it dies, at which point it turns to dust.
